title: Step 9b sends each page's customer-visible faults to the site agent as one numbered comment turn, undoes a turn that made a page worse, and hands over the written site on any error
steps: S1: Run the step 9 entry point tests with the site agent faked: node --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/tracy-web/test/write-step-nine-repair.test.mjs and its -faults and -turns siblings.
S2: Run the finder, finder door, bench command and image layout tests one file at a time: write-step-finder, door-ladder, write-step-bench-repair-cli, scripts/test/tracy-web-comment-turn-image.
expect: S1: every test passes: each fault is sent once with page, element and sentence; one turn per page; excluded kinds are never sent; a turn causing a new blocking failure is undone newest first; a prompt with no turn is resent once then dropped; one resend round; no new work after 10 minutes and a return by 12; any error hands over the written site with the first check; no faults means no turn; a brief's own values are logged not-demo; items carry the content.locate answer and the served selector on the served page address; late and duplicate turns are judged and undone; every wait races one step clock; an open turn is waited for, then cancelled and taken back; capped, unknown and invisible faults are logged with a code; the finder looks again before the resend round; the pages a turn changed come from its writes; undo failures are kept.
S2: every test passes, and comment-turn.mjs loads from the image layout the Dockerfile copies.
fence: The step 9 entry point's repair pass: what it sends to the site agent, what it undoes and what it hands over, checked with a fake site agent
